title: Correxit Corrector
description: Settings for the Correxit Corrector batch grading interface

concurrency.title: Grading concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of kernel connections active at any one time. This bounds running, restarting, and idle kernels combined.

timeout.title: Grading timeout
timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a single workbook to grade before abandoning it and freeing the kernel slot. Set to 0 to disable.

retries.title: Grading retries
retries.description: Number of additional passes over failed workbooks before giving up. Set to 0 for a single attempt with no retries.
